# 1 Clement Chapter 61 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 61 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_061_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 61

*[The Great Prayer — Part III: Prayer for Rulers, Closing Doxology]*

**61:1** You, Master, have given them the power of sovereignty through your excellent and unspeakable might, so that we, knowing the glory and honor given to them by you, may be subject to them — resisting nothing in your will. Grant to them, Lord, health, peace, harmony, and stability, that they may exercise the leadership given to them by you without offence.

**61:2** For you, O heavenly Master, King of the ages, give to the sons of men glory and honor and authority over the things upon the earth. Do you, Lord, direct their counsel according to what is good and well-pleasing before you, so that exercising in peace and in gentleness, in godliness, the authority given to them by you, they may obtain your mercy.

**61:3** O you who alone are able to do these things and far better things for us: we praise you through the High Priest and Guardian of our souls, Jesus Christ, through whom be the glory and the majesty to you, now and unto all generations and for ever and ever. Amen.

---

*EMET renders the Greek of Codex Alexandrinus with maximal literalness. Chapter 61 concludes the Great Prayer (chs. 59–61).*
